snapshot.what_they_sell: An AI Cloud and developer platform for building and deploying web and AI applications and agents; behind v0, Next.js, and the AI SDK. At Ship 2026 it described itself as an agentic infrastructure platform.
snapshot.who_they_sell_to: Developers and engineering teams building web and AI apps and agents. Vercel's own Series F post says Teams and Enterprise accounts are more than 50% of v0 revenue. Named customers include DoorDash, Helly Hansen, OpenAI, Stripe, and The Weather Company.
snapshot.size_and_stage: Late stage. Last confirmed primary round is the $300M Series F at a $9.3B post-money valuation (2025-09-30). Headcount is unverified: third-party estimates conflict (Crustdata 1,022 as of September 2026; Revelio about 885 as of March 2026).

pains.pain: Agents that act on Salesforce and Slack need governed, scoped credentials, and sales teams piloting AI outbound will need the same controls before connecting CRM data.
pains.reasoning: Vercel Connect GA on 2026-08-25 explicitly targets agents calling Salesforce and Slack with short-lived scoped tokens, audit logs, and RBAC, which bears directly on how an AI outbound tool would access CRM and messaging systems.

pains.pain: Vercel is hiring heavily in the US, so new reps will need to ramp fast, and manual prospecting will not keep up with that growth.
pains.reasoning: The trigger shows 65 open US roles on Vercel's own careers site as of October 13, 2026, which points to a fast-growing sales team. That AE hiring specifically, and the ramp and prospecting strain it creates, is an inference: the source does not say which roles are AE seats.

pains.reasoning: Tied to the company snapshot rather than a dated trigger: the CRO's January 2026 post states the AI-forward GTM goal. This is outside the 90-day window and is not a new event.
